```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
load("../../data/clinical.rds")
load("../../data/microbiome_metadata.rds")

# need sample year information 
```

```{r}
df <- mic.meta |>
  left_join(demographics) |>
  mutate(sample_name = sample,
         sample_title = paste0("MITOX stool metagenome from ", `Patient Id`),
         bioproject_accession = sample,
         organism = "gut metagenome",
         collection_date = "",
         env_broad_scale = "missing	urban biome [ENVO:01000249]",
         env_local_scale = "intestine environment [ENVO:2100002]",
         env_medium = "fecal material [ENVO:00002003]", 
         geo_loc_name = "USA:Ohio",
         host = "Homo sapiens", 
         # generic ohio
         lat_lon = "40.3674 N, 82.9962 W",
         
         ) |>
  select(sample_name, sample_title, bioproject_accession, organism, 
         collection_date, env_broad_scale, env_local_scale, env_medium, 
         geo_loc_name, host, lat_lon)
```
